Package com.leap.leaplaughlove.order.submission

Record Class OrderSubmissionResponse

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.leap.leaplaughlove.order.submission.OrderSubmissionResponse
Record Components:
orderId - the ID of the submitted order
accountId - the ID of the account under which the order was submitted
accountNumber - the account number associated with the order
instrumentId - the ID of the instrument being traded
symbol - the symbol of the instrument being traded
side - the side of the order (e.g., BUY or SELL)
quantity - the quantity of the order
status - the status of the order
submittedAt - the timestamp when the order was submitted
acceptedAt - the timestamp when the order was accepted
rejectedAt - the timestamp when the order was rejected
filledAt - the timestamp when the order was filled
rejectionReason - the reason for order rejection, if applicable
execution - the execution details of the order; null while the order is OPEN
accountBalanceAfter - the account balance after the order execution
orderType - MARKET, LIMIT, STOP or STOP_LIMIT
limitPrice - the limit price, for LIMIT and STOP_LIMIT orders
stopPrice - the stop price, for STOP and STOP_LIMIT orders
timeInForce - DAY or GTC; null for a market order
expiresAt - when an OPEN order expires if it hasn't filled
reservedCash - the cash an OPEN buy holds back from buying power
trailAmount - for a TRAILING_STOP, the dollars its stop trails the best price by
trailPercent - for a TRAILING_STOP, the percent its stop trails the best price by
extendedHours - whether a LIMIT order may also fill in pre-market and after-hours
collarPrice - for a market order queued for the open, the most a buy pays or the least a sell takes; null otherwise
public record OrderSubmissionResponse(UUID orderId, UUID accountId, String accountNumber, UUID instrumentId, String symbol, String side, long quantity, String status, OffsetDateTime submittedAt, OffsetDateTime acceptedAt, OffsetDateTime rejectedAt, OffsetDateTime filledAt, String rejectionReason, OrderSubmissionResponse.ExecutionDto execution, BigDecimal accountBalanceAfter, String orderType, BigDecimal limitPrice, BigDecimal stopPrice, String timeInForce, OffsetDateTime expiresAt, BigDecimal reservedCash, BigDecimal trailAmount, BigDecimal trailPercent, boolean extendedHours, BigDecimal collarPrice) extends Record
Response payload returned upon order submission and immediate execution processing.
